about.title: WE ARE PUTTA.
about.p1: Born in the void between luxury and utility. PUTTA represents a rejection of the unnecessary. We believe in the power of silence, structure, and form.
about.p2: Our garments are engineered for the modern individual who navigates the chaos of the city with calm confidence. We use premium materials, architectural cuts, and a monochromatic palette to create a uniform for the new era.
about.p3: We are not just a brand. We are a state of mind.
about.craftsmanshipText: Every piece is constructed with meticulous attention to detail. From the weight of the cotton to the finish of the hardware, nothing is overlooked.
about.sustainabilityText: We produce in limited quantities to minimize waste. Our materials are sourced responsibly, prioritizing longevity over trends.

productDetail.engineeredText: Engineered for durability and comfort. A staple piece for the modern wardrobe.

shipping.title: SHIPPING & RETURNS
shipping.freeShippingText: Free worldwide shipping on all orders.
shipping.processedText: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days. Once dispatched, delivery typically takes:
shipping.confirmationText: You'll receive a confirmation with tracking details once your order ships.
shipping.returnsText1: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery, provided items are unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging with tags attached.
shipping.returnsText2: To start a return, contact us with your order details and reason for return. We'll confirm the return address and next steps.
shipping.refundsText: Refunds are issued to the original payment method once the returned item is received and inspected.
shipping.exchangesText: Need a different size? Reach out and we'll arrange an exchange for you, subject to availability.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add items to your cart, select a size, and check out with your shipping details. Our team will reach out shortly after to confirm your order and arrange payment.
Domestic orders arrive in 3–5 business days, international orders in 7–14 business days, after 1–3 business days of processing. Shipping is free worldwide.
Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unworn, unwashed items with tags attached. See our Shipping & Returns page for full details.

items.q: How do I choose the right size?
items.a: Check the size selector on each product page, or ask our AI Stylist for a recommendation based on your height and weight.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Yes — contact us as soon as possible after checkout. Once an order has shipped, changes are no longer possible.

contact.title: CONTACT US
contact.text: Questions about an order, sizing, or anything else? Reach out and our team will get back to you.

sizeGuide.title: SIZE GUIDE
sizeGuide.subtitle: PUTTA runs true to an oversized fit. Measurements below are approximate — for a more relaxed look, size up.
